C:S3.1.text: It provides rail, truck and marine terminaling, pipeline transportation and storage services to PBF Holding and its subsidiaries and to third-party customers under fee-based commercial agreements.

C:S5.1.text: Products are marketed to customers in the United States and abroad through a network of dealers and wholesalers, and PBF has no company-owned or branded retail outlets.
